env_file.description: EnvFile is a dotenv file in the repo, such as .env.production.

prefix.description: Prefix keeps only variables whose names start with it, such as VITE_.

from_secret.description: FromSecret reads dotenv-style values from the secret store.

name.description: Name is how workloads refer to the image.

repository.description: Repository is the container repository name; defaults to Name.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile is relative to the repo root; defaults to "Dockerfile".

context.description: Context is the build context, relative to the repo root; defaults to ".".

template_var.description:
TemplateVar is the placeholder manifests use for this image; defaults to
NAME_IMAGE (upper snake case), as in ${API_IMAGE}.

build_args.description: BuildArgs are passed to the build as --build-arg values.

build_per_environment.description:
BuildPerEnvironment rebuilds the image for each environment from the same
commit instead of promoting one image. Set it for front ends that bake
environment settings in at build time.

Image.description: Image is a container image built from this repo.

names.description: Names are the pilets this repo publishes.

command.description: Command publishes one pilet; "{name}" is replaced with the pilet's name.

env.description: Env is passed to the command as environment variables, such as the feed key.

Pilets.description: Pilets are Piral micro-frontends published from this repo.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes Secret's name.

from.description: From is where its values live in the secret store.

Secret.description: Secret is a Kubernetes Secret filled from the secret store.

SecretRef.description: A secret in the secret store: secret:<scope>/<name>, optionally #<key>.

component.description: Component is the component's registry name, such as jobs-service.

version.description: Version is a released version of the component, such as 1.8.0.

commit.description:
Commit pins a commit instead of a version, for components that have not
started tagging releases yet.

as.description: As is the name workloads use for this image; defaults to Component.

template_var.description: TemplateVar is the placeholder manifests use; defaults to AS_IMAGE.

Use.description: Use pins a shared component this app deploys.

name.description: Name is the workload's name; for a deployment, the Deployment's name.

kind.description: Kind decides how Dray waits for it: deployments roll out, cronjobs are applied.

images.description:
Images are stamped into the manifests by digest. Names refer to images
built here or to components in uses. Empty for a workload whose images are
all third-party.

manifests.description: Manifests are relative to the repo root.

depends_on.description: DependsOn lists workloads that must be applied first.

secrets.description: Secrets lists secrets (by name) that must exist before this workload.

manual.description: Manual workloads ship only when named, never in a whole-repo deploy.

disabled.description: Disabled workloads are kept in the config but never deployed.

rollout_timeout.description:
RolloutTimeout is how long to wait for a rollout; defaults to 600s,
Kubernetes' own progress deadline.

Workload.description: Workload is a set of manifests deployed together.

name.description: Name is the app's name. It must match the app's registry entry.

images.description: Images are built from this repo.

uses.description: Uses pins shared components that this app deploys but does not build.

workloads.description: Workloads are what gets deployed: manifests plus the images stamped into them.

secrets.description: Secrets are Kubernetes Secrets the workloads need, filled from the secret store.

pilets.description: Pilets are Piral micro-frontends published to a feed.

title: Dray repo config (.dray/config.yaml)
description: RepoConfig is a repo's .dray/config.yaml: what to build and what to deploy.
